class TaggedSourceConsumerTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def fixture(self, directory):
        base = Path(directory)
        root,source_root = base/'consumers/source',base/'candidate'
        root.mkdir(parents=True);source_root.mkdir()
        sdk = b'{"sdk":{"version":"10.0.401"}}'
        (root/'global.json').write_bytes(sdk)
        binding = {'candidate_source':{'repository':str(source_root),'main':{'files':[{'path':'global.json','sha256':q.digest(sdk)}]}}}
        manifest = {'role':'source','configuration':'Debug','projects':[]}
        for project in ('Host','Domain','Probe'):
            stem = project.lower()
            files = {'assets':stem+'/obj/project.assets.json','lock':stem+'/packages.lock.json','loaded':'loaded/'+project+'.json'}
            output = stem+'/bin/Debug/net10.0'
            references = {str(source_root/'src'/name/(name+'.csproj')):{} for name in q.SUCCESSOR_PACKAGE_IDS}
            consumer_project = root/stem/(project+'.csproj')
            consumer_project.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);consumer_project.write_text('<Project />')
            for name in q.SUCCESSOR_PACKAGE_IDS:
                source_project = source_root/'src'/name/(name+'.csproj')
                source_project.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);source_project.write_text('<Project />')
            loaded = []
            for name in q.SUCCESSOR_PACKAGE_IDS:
                # Build outputs are shared; each consumer loads the same actual source assembly.
                data = name.encode()
                for path in (root/output/(name+'.dll'),source_root/'src'/name/'bin/Debug/net10.0'/(name+'.dll')):
                    path.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);path.write_bytes(data)
                loaded.append({'name':name,'path':str(root/output/(name+'.dll')),'sha256':q.digest(data)})
            values = {'assets':{'project':{'restore':{'projectPath':str(consumer_project),'frameworks':{'net10.0':{'projectReferences':references}}}},
                                'libraries':{'Server':{'type':'project','path':os.path.relpath(source_root/'src/Hexalith.EventStore.Server/Hexalith.EventStore.Server.csproj',consumer_project.parent)}}},
                      'lock':{},'loaded':{'assemblies':loaded}}
            for name,path in files.items():
                (root/path).parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);q.write_json(root/path,values[name])
            manifest['projects'].append({'name':project,'output':output,**files})
        q.write_json(root/'evidence.json',manifest)
        return root,binding

    def testIndependentSourceGraphProofRejectsRehashedRootAndLoadedBinarySubstitution(self):
        for mutation in (None,'root','assembly','sdk','lock','project-path','missing-project'):
            with self.subTest(mutation=mutation),tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
                root,binding = self.fixture(directory)
                path = root/'source-evidence.json'
                q.write_json(path,q.source_consumer_binding(root,binding))
                reference = {'path':str(path),'sha256':q.digest(path.read_bytes()),'content':path.read_text()}
                if mutation == 'root':
                    assets = root/'host/obj/project.assets.json'
                    data = q.parse_json(assets.read_bytes())
                    refs = data['project']['restore']['frameworks']['net10.0']['projectReferences']
                    key = next(iter(refs));refs[str(q.ROOT/'src/Substituted.csproj')] = refs.pop(key)
                    q.write_json(assets,data)
                    record = q.parse_json(path.read_bytes())
                    next(item for item in record['files'] if item['path']==str(assets))['sha256'] = q.digest(assets.read_bytes())
                    q.write_json(path,record)
                    reference.update(sha256=q.digest(path.read_bytes()),content=path.read_text())
                elif mutation == 'assembly':
                    (root/'host/bin/Debug/net10.0/Hexalith.EventStore.Server.dll').write_bytes(b'substituted')
                elif mutation == 'sdk':
                    (root/'global.json').write_text('{"sdk":{"version":"10.0.402"}}')
                elif mutation == 'lock':
                    (root/'host/packages.lock.json').write_text('{"substituted":true}')
                elif mutation == 'project-path':
                    assets = root/'host/obj/project.assets.json'
                    data = q.parse_json(assets.read_bytes());data['project']['restore']['projectPath'] = str(root/'other/Host.csproj')
                    q.write_json(assets,data)
                elif mutation == 'missing-project':
                    (Path(binding['candidate_source']['repository'])/'src/Hexalith.EventStore.Server/Hexalith.EventStore.Server.csproj').unlink()
                if mutation is None:
                    q.validate_source_consumer({'source_consumer':reference},binding)
                else:
                    with self.assertRaises(preparation.InvalidPacket):
                        q.validate_source_consumer({'source_consumer':reference},binding)

class CleanupTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def worker(self, scratch):
        worker = executor.Executor.__new__(executor.Executor)
        worker.output = Path(scratch) / "receipts-output"
        worker.output.mkdir()
        worker.scratch = Path(scratch) / "owned-scratch"
        worker.scratch.mkdir()
        worker.invocation = "1" * 32
        worker.fixture = {"id": "synthetic-control", "synthetic": True}
        worker.inputs = None
        worker.inputs_sha256 = None
        worker.commands, worker.receipts, worker.errors = [], [], []
        worker.processes, worker.active, worker.containers = [], [], {}
        worker.pending_containers = {}
        worker.configurations = []
        preparation.subreaper()
        worker.shared_before = {}
        worker.result = {"errors": [], "receipts": []}
        return worker

    def testCleanupContinuesAfterOneFailureAndRepeatsEveryTarget(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
            worker = self.worker(scratch)
            worker.containers = {"bad": {}, "good": {}}
            visited = []
            def run(argv, **kwargs):
                visited.append(tuple(argv))
                if argv[:2] == ["docker", "inspect"] and len(argv) == 5:
                    identity = argv[-1]
                    if identity == "bad":
                        raise RuntimeError("synthetic injected cleanup failure")
                    worker.commands.append({"exit_code": 0})
                    return json.dumps({"Id": identity, "Config": {"Labels": {"hexalith.p1r.invocation": worker.invocation}}}).encode()
                return b""
            with mock.patch.object(worker, "run", side_effect=run):
                receipt = worker.cleanup()
            self.assertEqual(sum(row == ("docker", "rm", "-f", "good") for row in visited), 2)
            self.assertEqual(receipt["attempts"][-1]["remaining"], ["bad"])
            self.assertEqual(receipt["execution"], "failed")
            self.assertEqual(receipt["scope"], "tooling-synthetic")
            self.assertEqual(receipt["compatibility"], "unverified")
            self.assertFalse(worker.scratch.exists())

    def testInterruptedActualChildIsRemovedAndRepeatedCleanupIsIdempotent(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
            worker = self.worker(scratch)
            child = worker.launch([sys.executable, "-I", "-c", "import time; time.sleep(60)"], dict())
            identity = child["ownership"].root
            preparation.signal_owned(identity, __import__("signal").SIGINT)
            def discovery(argv, **kwargs):
                return b""
            with mock.patch.object(worker, "run", side_effect=discovery):
                receipt = worker.cleanup()
            self.assertFalse(preparation.same_process(identity, preparation.process_state(identity["pid"])))
            self.assertEqual(receipt["attempts"][-1]["remaining"], [])
            self.assertEqual(len(receipt["attempts"]), 2)
            self.assertEqual(receipt["scope"], "tooling-synthetic")

    def testInterruptionRetainsPartialCaseAndPropagatesAfterOwnedCleanup(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as scratch:
            worker = self.worker(scratch)
            calls = []
            def interrupt(checks):
                checks.check("started", True)
                raise KeyboardInterrupt()
            with mock.patch.object(worker, "stop_nodes", side_effect=lambda: calls.append("cleanup")):
                with self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt):
                    worker.case("full-replay", "synthetic-interruption", interrupt, True)
            self.assertEqual(calls, ["cleanup"])
            retained = list((worker.output / "interrupted").glob("*.json"))
            self.assertEqual(len(retained), 1)
            value = json.loads(retained[0].read_bytes())
            self.assertEqual(value["case"]["assertions"], {"attempted": 2, "passed": 1, "failed": 1})
